data.title: Powering Community Resilience, Bloom Energy Supports First Responders in State College during ESPN College Campus Tour
data.description: In State College, Pennsylvania, Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) extended its sponsorship with ESPN Radio’s College Campus Tour powered by Bloom with a $10,000 donation to Alpha Fire Company. The contribution was presented before the Penn State-Wisconsin game to show support for the all-volunteer department established in 1899. The funds aim to assist the firefighters, first responders, and public servants dedicated to safeguarding the State College community.

data.title: Chase Launches Data Security Center to Help Customers Manage Connected Apps and Third-Party Data Sharing
data.description: Recently in New York, Chase launched its Data Security Center in a gradual release, aiding customers in comprehending and controlling the sharing of their financial data with external applications. The initiative aims to enhance transparency and effectiveness in data sharing, empowering customers to track and manage where their data is transmitted. This enables informed choices regarding connected apps and the ability to retain control over such connections.

data.title: Bitget Hack Results in $387M Losses; North Korea Suspected due to $387.5M drained via fake transfers: CEO.
data.description: A cyber attacker used fake internal transfer requests to steal approximately $387.5 million from Bitget's hot and warm wallets. The exchange's CEO has suggested that the fingerprints left behind by the attacker resemble those linked to North Korea.

data.title: Annamycin Turns “Cold” Pancreatic Tumors “Hot” in New Preclinical Data Presented at AACR
data.description: New information revealed at the AACR Conference on Pancreatic Cancer suggests that the antitumor effects of Annamycin may be linked to CD8+ T cells. This indicates a potential immune-mediated component in addition to its direct cytotoxic effects.
